blocking: [claude-fallback] Upload finalize double-counts its own reservation. B/project/docs/downgrade-policy.md:91 defines `assertCanUpload(size)` as "`storedBytes + reservedBytes + size ≤ limits.storageBytes`", and line 93 says "Getting a signed upload URL calls `assertCanUpload`, and so does finalizing the upload." At finalize, reservedBytes already includes this upload's reservation, so the size is counted twice. Example: at 1.47 GB used, a 20 MB upload passes at start (1.49 GB) and fails at finalize (1.51 GB). Line 95 then says "finalizing fails and the object is deleted", so a valid upload gets rejected and destroyed.

[claude-fallback] Photo deletion contradicts itself for uncovered books. Principle line 12 says Free limits "never stop the user from reading, exporting, rearranging, or deleting what they already have". But line 32 "Edit pages, layout, text, or photo placement | No: `book_not_covered`" and line 93 "edits to a book's pages, layout, text, or photos call `assertBookCovered`" gate removing a single photo from any of the 15 read-only books. What would ship is the gate: a user over storage whose large photos sit in newer books can only free space by trashing whole books or shuffling coverage first.
